batch: Classify three thematic studies from two DOI-deposited abstracts and one complete chapter
policy: These are work-scope judgments only. They do not certify complete object extraction, endorse readings, resolve identities or authenticity, or change text and media rights.

entries.basis: The DOI-deposited abstract centers material affordances, affect, preparation and physical caregiving in late-antique household medicine rather than editing a bowl text.
The DOI-deposited abstract categorizes bowl spells by three kinds of biblical citation and studies their textual, linguistic and social implications.
The complete inspected chapter compares several Schøyen bowls to investigate formula composition, variation, memory and transmission rather than presenting a corpus edition.
